transcript:
Customer: I am so tired of these hidden charges on my bill! This is absolutely ridiculous and I'm done with this service.
Agent: Yeah, what's the problem?
Customer: I'm Vivek Patel and I'm paying for a plan I don't even use. I want to change my plan to the basic one immediately or I'm switching to another provider today.
Agent: Which phone number are we talking about?
Customer: It is 98911 17158.
Agent: I see the account. Which plan do you want?
Customer: The basic one. I've already sent emails from vivek.85@examplemail.com and nobody replied to me for three days!
Agent: I am switching you to the basic plan now.
Customer: Finally! I just wanted this sorted out without all the stress.
Agent: I will process the plan change and send a confirmation SMS to your device.
Customer: Thank you, I appreciate you actually getting it done quickly.
Agent: Is there anything else? I have updated the plan and you will receive the SMS shortly. Goodbye.
